question: Annie Besant laid the foundation of the Central Hindu College in ______ in 1898 where both Hindu religion and Western scientific subjects were taught.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Benaras.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant**, a **British theosophist** and** women's rights activis**t, laid the foundation of the** Central Hindu College** in **Benaras in 1898**.
 
• The college aimed to provide a** modern education** while also preserving **Hindu culture and traditions.**
 
• In **1916**, the college was renamed as **Banaras Hindu University (BHU)** and became a prominent institution of higher education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Annie Besant did establish the **Theosophical Society in India** in **1879 **with its headquarters in** Adyar, Chennai.**
 
• She composed an** essay in 1902** about British policies.
 
• She was elected** president **of the Theosophical Society in **1907.**
 
• Together with **Bal Gangadhar Tilak,** she founded the **All India Home Rule League **in **1916.**
 
• She was chosen to lead the** Indian National Congress** (INC) in **1917.**
